title: Tracecat 1.2.0
body_markdown:
## Security


- security(agents): Add discovery-only deferred MCP actions (ENG-1939) ([#3732](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3732) )


## Case management


- fix(cases): Show detected MIME type in attachment content errors ([#3820](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3820) )
- perf(cases): Debounce searches and cancel superseded requests ([#3800](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3800) )
- feat(cases): Combine exact lookup with filtered case search ([#3793](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3793) )
- fix(cases): Validate tag filters and escape literal search ([#3792](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3792) )
- feat(tables+cases): Add shared text search contracts ([#3790](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3790) )
- feat(cases): Open cases in a side panel from the list ([#3785](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3785) )
- perf(cases): Debounce the cases search input ([#3781](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3781) )
- feat(cases): Search cases by case UUID or unpadded short ID ([#3776](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3776) )
- fix(cases): Re-parent sub-cases migration to restore one Alembic head ([#3774](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3774) )
- docs(cases): Move trigger agents after case actions in overview ([#3768](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3768) )
- docs(cases): Split case management into build and resolve guides ([#3766](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3766) )
- feat(enterprise+cases): Add sub-cases for grouping related cases ([#3736](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3736) )


## Tables


- perf(tables): Benchmark lexical search storage safety ([#3823](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3823) )
- fix(tables): Distinguish unique indexes from search indexes ([#3789](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3789) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Give the playground chat the workspace chat padding ([#3849](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3849) )
- fix(agents): Classify mid-stream provider rate limits ([#3845](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3845) )
- fix(mcp): Prioritize integration actions in discovery ([#3834](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3834) )
- feat(agents): Filter agents by MCP server and workflow ([#3833](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3833) )
- fix(agents): Share one tenant OTel delivery pool (ENG-2046) ([#3819](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3819) )
- fix(agents): Release a chat whose turn never started (ENG-2039) ([#3810](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3810) )
- feat(agents): Flatten agent preset ui/ux ([#3798](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3798) )
- fix(agents): Retry LLM gateway connections dropped before headers ([#3782](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3782) )
- feat(api+agents): Let workspace API keys list workspace agent models ([#3777](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3777) )
- feat(ui+agents): Bring agent tools picker to workflows and skills ([#3762](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3762) )
- feat(agents): Add Claude Haiku 5.5 and Mythos 5/5.1 to platform catalog ([#3760](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3760) )
- feat(skills): Install prebuilt Tracecat skills from a library ([#3662](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3662) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(mcp+build): Find matching actions and refresh plugins ([#3832](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3832) )
- fix(mcp): Prefer integration actions over core and Python ([#3831](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3831) )
- feat(mcp): Add cancel_workflow_execution tool ([#3780](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3780) )
- feat(mcp): Add use_in_chat to agent preset create and update tools ([#3772](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3772) )


## Integrations


- fix(integrations): Surface Git sync pull errors ([#3839](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3839) )
- fix(integrations): Try user tokens before the app token for gists ([#3836](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3836) )
- perf(integrations): Speed up Git sync pull apply ([#3835](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3835) )
- fix(integrations): Let the GitHub gist actions use a personal access token ([#3818](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3818) )


## Engine


- feat(engine+ui): Rerun past runs with fixed action results ([#3829](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3829) )
- fix(engine): Allow sandbox DNS to CNI-rewritten resolver CIDRs ([#3828](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3828) )
- perf(engine): Prepare cold registry artifacts in parallel ([#3806](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3806) )
- perf(engine): Stop warm registry remounts from waiting on downloads ([#3805](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3805) )
- feat(enterprise+engine): Route actions through tunnel gateways ([#3796](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3796) )
- fix(engine): Time out only the action call, not platform work ([#3794](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3794) )
- feat(enterprise+engine): Add Pangolin gateway and managed tunnels ([#3784](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3784) )


## API


- test(api): Shorten form image test IDs ([#3841](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3841) )
- fix(api): Enforce form scopes on sync and retry blob deletes ([#3827](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3827) )
- feat(api+ui): Add workflow forms ([#3817](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3817) )
- feat(enterprise+api): Add workspace-scoped Pangolin tunnels API ([#3783](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3783) )


## User interface


- fix(ui): Resize cramped dialogs and stop missing-integration toast ([#3846](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3846) )
- feat(ui): Remove Beta tag from Chat in the sidebar ([#3842](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3842) )
- fix(ui): Polish sub-case actions, tab order, and row hover ([#3824](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3824) )
- fix(ui): Chat approval, run status and Inbox display fixes ([#3822](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3822) )
- fix(ui): Keep folder picker dropdowns within the viewport ([#3816](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3816) )
- fix(ui): Show conversation compaction in chat again (ENG-2029) ([#3809](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3809) )
- feat(ui): Standardize dialogs on fixed-height scrolling panels ([#3788](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3788) )
- feat(ui): Refresh AI and core action icons ([#3787](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3787) )
- feat(ui): Git sync ux overhaul ([#3763](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3763) )


## Infrastructure


- docs(infra): Recommend CloudNativePG with pgvector on Kubernetes ([#3815](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3815) )
- infra: Unmask Fargate task definitions in Terraform plans ([#3803](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3803) )
- infra: Enable pg_trgm during application migrations ([#3791](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3791) )
- infra: Disable Fargate WAF XSS and LFI body blocks ([#3756](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3756) )


## Documentation


- docs: Add a Google OAuth app lifecycle example ([#3799](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3799) )
- docs: Refresh README agent gif with the preset builder ([#3770](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3770) )
- docs: Update stable installation references to 1.1.0 ([#3769](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3769) )
- docs: Rename cases page title to Overview ([#3765](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3765) )
- docs: Reorganize nav into Automations, Cases, and Platform tabs ([#3764](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3764) )


## Dependencies


- build(deps): Patch handlebars, next, sharp, pymongo, mcp alerts ([#3851](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3851) )


## Build system


- build: Speed up API and UI image builds ([#3767](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3767) )
